text: Japan has eight million gods. But why? Where do they come from? Almost every religion has a book, a story to follow. But Japan's... I went looking, and couldn't find much. So what is it called? It's called Shinto. In Japanese, it means: the way of the kami. ... The truth is, nobody founded it. It began with farmers, more than two thousand years ago. They grew rice, and rice depended on rain, sun, and soil. So they thanked what they couldn't control: the mountain, the river, the storm. ... Around the year seven hundred, two books wrote the old stories down. They say the sun goddess Amaterasu once hid in a cave, and the whole world went dark. The gods threw a party to bring her out. And the emperors claimed her as their ancestor.
